overview:
Discover the Himalayas with Safar Trails’ Himachal Grand Adventure Tour – 6 Nights / 7 Days. Explore Shimla, Manali, Kufri, Solang Valley, Kasol, and Manikaran through scenic mountain drives, cultural attractions, and optional adventure activities.

With comfortable stays, transfers, sightseeing, and meals as selected, this package is ideal for families, couples, and adventure lovers seeking a memorable Himachal getaway.

itinerary.title: Delhi/Chandigarh to Shimla
itinerary.description:
Begin your Himachal Grand Adventure Tour with departure from Delhi or Chandigarh towards Shimla. Enjoy a scenic drive through the Himalayan foothills, with changing landscapes and mountain views along the way.

On arrival in Shimla, check in to your hotel and relax after the journey. In the evening, explore Mall Road and The Ridge at your leisure. Enjoy the pleasant hill-station atmosphere before returning to your hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.
itinerary.morningActivity: Departure from Delhi or Chandigarh & scenic drive through Himalayan foothills
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Arrival in Shimla, hotel check-in, and relaxation after the journey
itinerary.eveningActivity: Leisurely exploration of Mall Road and The Ridge; dinner at hotel
itinerary.transfers: Private transfers from Delhi/Chandigarh to Shimla

itinerary.title: Shimla and Kufri Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, proceed for a sightseeing tour of Shimla and Kufri. Visit Kufri, known for its mountain scenery, followed by Green Valley and Himalayan Nature Park, subject to opening hours and local access.

Continue to Jakhoo Temple, an important local attraction. Later, explore The Ridge and Christ Church before spending some free time on Mall Road for shopping, cafés and local exploration.

Return to your hotel in the evening. Enjoy dinner and a relaxing overnight stay in Shimla.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast & excursion to Kufri, Green Valley and Himalayan Nature Park
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Visit Jakhoo Temple, The Ridge, and historic Christ Church
itinerary.eveningActivity: Free time on Mall Road for shopping and cafés; dinner and overnight stay

itinerary.title: Shimla to Manali
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from your hotel and begin your journey towards Manali. Enjoy a scenic drive through Himalayan valleys, taking in beautiful mountain and river views along the route.

On arrival in Manali, check in to your hotel and relax after the journey. The evening is free for leisure, allowing you to enjoy the surroundings or explore nearby areas depending on arrival time.

Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast, check out from Shimla hotel & scenic mountain drive towards Manali
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Scenic valley drive with beautiful mountain and river views along the route
itinerary.eveningActivity: Check in to Manali hotel, relaxation, evening leisure, and dinner
itinerary.transfers: Private intercity transfer from Shimla to Manali

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, begin your local sightseeing tour of Manali. Visit Hadimba Devi Temple, known for its distinctive architecture and forest setting, followed by Manu Temple.

Continue to Vashisht Temple and the nearby hot water springs. Explore Van Vihar and visit the Tibetan Monastery to experience another side of Manali’s cultural character.

Later, spend time at Mall Road and the local market, where you can browse shops, cafés and regional products.

Return to the hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast & visit to Hadimba Devi Temple and Manu Temple
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Visit Vashisht hot springs, Van Vihar, and Tibetan Monastery
itinerary.eveningActivity: Explore Mall Road and local markets for souvenirs and cafés; dinner at hotel

itinerary.title: Solang Valley – Atal Tunnel – Sissu
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, set out for a full-day excursion towards Solang Valley, a popular destination for Himalayan scenery and outdoor experiences. Enjoy the mountain views and consider optional adventure activities, available at additional cost and subject to weather and local operating conditions.

Continue towards Atal Tunnel and Sissu if road access, weather and local travel conditions permit. Spend time admiring the surrounding landscapes and taking photographs at suitable locations.

Later, return to Manali by evening for dinner and an overnight stay.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast & excursion to Solang Valley for mountain views & optional adventure sports
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Drive through Atal Tunnel to Sissu (subject to road, weather & access conditions)
itinerary.eveningActivity: Scenic return drive to Manali; dinner and overnight stay

itinerary.title: Manali – Manikaran – Kasol – Manali
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, proceed towards Kasol and Manikaran for a day of scenic exploration. Enjoy the landscapes of the Parvati Valley and spend some leisure time exploring Kasol’s local market.

Continue to Manikaran and visit the famous Gurudwara and hot springs. Take time to appreciate the area’s spiritual atmosphere and surrounding mountain scenery.

After sightseeing, return to Manali in the evening. Enjoy dinner and your final overnight stay in Manali.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast & drive into Parvati Valley towards Kasol
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Explore Kasol local market, visit Manikaran Gurudwara & natural hot springs
itinerary.eveningActivity: Scenic return to Manali, dinner, and final overnight stay

itinerary.title: Manali to Delhi/Chandigarh Departure
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from your hotel and begin the return journey towards Delhi or Chandigarh. Enjoy the scenic Himalayan route as you travel back from the mountains.

On arrival, you will be dropped at the agreed departure location, concluding your Himachal Grand Adventure Tour with memorable experiences of Shimla, Manali, Solang Valley, Kasol and the surrounding Himalayan landscapes.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast at hotel, check-out & begin return journey
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Scenic drive down through mountain valleys towards plains
itinerary.eveningActivity: Drop-off at agreed departure location in Delhi or Chandigarh; tour concludes

topPlacesToVisit.name: Shimla
topPlacesToVisit.description: Shimla is a charming hill station known for its mountain scenery, heritage attractions and lively shopping areas. It is the first destination on this tour and provides a relaxing introduction to Himachal Pradesh. Top places and experiences: Mall Road, The Ridge, Christ Church, local shopping and cafés, scenic walks and mountain views.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Kufri
topPlacesToVisit.description: Kufri is a popular excursion from Shimla, known for its surrounding hills and outdoor attractions. The visit offers an opportunity to enjoy the landscape beyond the main town. Top places and experiences: Kufri sightseeing, Himalayan Nature Park (subject to opening and access), Green Valley, and mountain photography.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Manali
topPlacesToVisit.description: Manali combines Himalayan landscapes, cultural attractions, temples and a lively town centre. It serves as the base for several sightseeing excursions during the tour. Top places and experiences: Hadimba Devi Temple, Manu Temple, Vashisht Temple and hot water springs, Van Vihar, Tibetan Monastery, Mall Road and local markets.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Solang Valley
topPlacesToVisit.description: Solang Valley is known for its open mountain scenery and seasonal outdoor activities. It is a major highlight for visitors seeking nature and adventure experiences near Manali. Top places and experiences: Mountain viewpoints, photography, seasonal snow experiences, and optional adventure activities at additional cost.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Atal Tunnel and Sissu
topPlacesToVisit.description: The Atal Tunnel–Sissu excursion offers dramatic mountain scenery and a chance to explore landscapes beyond Manali. Access depends on road conditions, weather and local restrictions. Top places and experiences: Scenic mountain drive, Atal Tunnel route (subject to access), Sissu landscape and viewpoints, photography and sightseeing.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Kasol
topPlacesToVisit.description: Kasol is a scenic destination in the Parvati Valley, popular for its mountain setting and relaxed atmosphere. The itinerary includes leisure time to explore the local market. Top places and experiences: Parvati Valley scenery, local market exploration, cafés and leisure time, and photography.

topPlacesToVisit.name: Manikaran
topPlacesToVisit.description: Manikaran is known for its Gurudwara and hot springs, making it an important cultural and spiritual stop during the excursion from Manali. Top places and experiences: Manikaran Gurudwara, hot springs, local exploration, and views of the surrounding valley.

faqs.question: How many days are needed for the Himachal Grand Adventure Tour?
faqs.answer: The itinerary covers 6 Nights / 7 Days, with visits to Shimla, Kufri, Manali, Solang Valley, Atal Tunnel, Sissu, Kasol and Manikaran.

faqs.question: Can I start this Himachal tour package from Delhi or Chandigarh?
faqs.answer: Yes. The supplied itinerary offers departure from Delhi or Chandigarh, with the return drop at the agreed location.

faqs.question: Which destinations are covered in the Himachal Grand Adventure Tour?
faqs.answer: The tour covers Shimla, Kufri, Manali, Solang Valley, the Atal Tunnel–Sissu route, Kasol and Manikaran.

faqs.question: Is accommodation included in the tour package?
faqs.answer: The itinerary specifies hotel stays. The final quotation should confirm the hotel category, property details, room type and number of nights in each destination.

faqs.question: Are meals included in the Himachal tour package?
faqs.answer: Meals are listed as selected. Please confirm the exact meal plan and whether breakfast, dinner or other meals are included in your quotation.

faqs.question: Are adventure activities included in Solang Valley?

faqs.question: Can we visit Atal Tunnel and Sissu throughout the year?
faqs.answer: Access depends on weather, snowfall, road conditions and local restrictions. The excursion may need to be modified or cancelled if travel is unsafe or the route is closed.

faqs.question: What can I see in Shimla and Kufri?
faqs.answer: The itinerary includes Mall Road, The Ridge, Christ Church, Kufri, Green Valley, Himalayan Nature Park and Jakhoo Temple, subject to access and opening hours.

faqs.question: What are the main attractions in Manali?

faqs.question: Is this tour suitable for families and couples?
faqs.answer: Yes, the mix of sightseeing, cultural attractions and scenic drives can suit families, couples and groups. Travellers should consider the long mountain journeys and seasonal weather when planning.

faqs.answer: The suitable travel period depends on your priorities, such as pleasant weather, greenery or snow experiences. Conditions vary by destination and season, particularly around Solang Valley, Atal Tunnel and Sissu. Confirm the latest conditions before finalising your trip.
